about: Independent golden for per-model recommended audio.cpp options (PLAN AC1/AC2/AC5/AC8/AC12). Per model id, one case per workflow (ACE-Step: per variant prefix). include = must be offered with this default (null = offered but sends nothing); optional = may be offered, but if so with this default (null = never sent); exclude = must not be offered. 'names' lists accepted aliases for one option. Sources: W:<key> = webui/configs/model_params.json, R = C++ runtime default, spec==runtime = embedded spec agrees with the runtime, decision Qn = user decision.
